LanguageData.StatCompression_ShowInfoCardSettingsButt: Show the "Compression settings" button on info cards
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_BodyPartHealth_Baseli: This affects the HP of every body part. Baseline represents a pawn's unmodified base body-part HP for its race. For convenience, this value is normalized to 1 (100%); 2 means double HP.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_Damage_BaselineToolti: For base-damage modules, Baseline is the base damage of equipment, pawns, or items. For example, if a punch deals 9 damage, its baseline is 9.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_Damage_DirectionToolt: Base damage only supports compressing values above the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_HediffStageFactor_Bas: This is a Hediff (health condition) field. Baseline 1 represents 100% of the base value; 2 means double the value.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_RegenerationRate_Base: The regeneration Baseline is measured in HP per day. A typical pawn has 0 HP/day, while a ghoul may have 100 HP/day or more.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_HediffStage_Direction: The direction is fixed by the field's game semantics: high healing/regeneration values are compressed, while low bleed, hunger, rest-fall, and food-poisoning factors are compressed.
LanguageData.StatCompression_MethodTooltip: Different ways to reduce high values. Compression becomes stronger from left to right.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Formula_Logarithmic: Logarithmic: f(x) = h + ln(1 + ln(t)(x - h)) / ln(t)
LanguageData.StatCompression_Formula_SoftCap: Soft cap: f(x) = h + t(x - h) / ((x - h) + t)
LanguageData.StatCompression_ParameterTooltip: Adjust this value to change compression strength. The slider provides a convenient range; values outside it can be entered manually.
LanguageData.StatCompression_CompressAboveTooltip: Baseline is the preset reference value for a stat. For example, 150% work speed or 5.0 movement speed may each be treated as 100% of their baseline. When the stat's baseline percentage crosses this threshold, only the excess is compressed. Special lower-is-better stats, such as Incoming Damage Factor, use a different formula.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Preset_ErrorInvalidName: The preset name cannot be used as a file name.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Preset_ErrorNoSelection: Select at least one config row.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ImportedMessage: Imported settings XML: updated={0}, skipped={1}, path={2}
LanguageData.StatCompression_ResizeColumnTooltip: Drag to resize this column. Click the header to sort.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SelectStatForPreview: Select a stat row to preview its compression mapping.
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedPreviewFormulaHi: B = positive baseline; T = B * threshold; e = (value - T) / B value <= T: result = value value > T: result = T + B * C(e) C(e) = {0}; actual t = {1}
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedPreviewFormulaLo: x = value / baseline; r = 1 / x; h = threshold; e = r - h r <= h: result = value r > h: result = baseline / (h + C(e)) C(e) = {0}; actual t = {1}
B = positive baseline; T = B * threshold; e = (T - value) / B value >= T: result = value value < T: result = T - B * C(e) C(e) = {0}; actual t = {1}
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedHelp: Configure compression for each stat. Follow global uses the global Method and t; a specific Method uses that method's default t. Baseline remains positive; direct directions allow a negative threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedFormulaHelp: For normalized excess e: Linear C(e)=et; Power C(e)=(e+1)^t-1; Logarithmic C(e)=ln(1+ln(t)e)/ln(t); Soft cap C(e)=te/(e+t).
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionHelp: Direction selects which part of the value is compressed: "Higher direct" processes the portion above the threshold; "Lower ratio" takes the reciprocal, compresses the portion above the threshold, then takes the reciprocal again; "Lower direct" processes the additive difference below the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionExplanation_Hig: Directly compress the portion above the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionExplanation_Low: Take the reciprocal, directly compress the portion above the threshold, then take the reciprocal again.
Directly compress the portion below the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionTooltip: Higher direct: directly compress the portion above the threshold. Lower ratio: take the reciprocal, directly compress the portion above the threshold, then take the reciprocal again. Lower direct: directly compress the portion below the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_TScaleTooltip: Adjust this value to change compression strength.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Power: Power compression: multiplicative gains are proportionally reduced
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Power_L: Power compression: multiplicative gains are proportionally reduced
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Logarit: Logarithmic compression: multiplicative gains become additive
Logarithmic compression: multiplicative gains become additive
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_SoftCap: Soft cap compression: values never exceed a fixed upper limit.
Soft cap compression: values never fall below a fixed lower limit.
LanguageData.StatCompression_BaseDamage_Info_AfterFac: Only the base damage is shown here. Equipment, pawn, material, and other factors are applied afterward.
